title: Rappler Talk: UN Special Envoy Jean Todt on making roads safer
summary: In this Rappler Talk episode, multimedia reporter Patrick Cruz sits down with former Ferrari CEO and UN Special Envoy for Road Safety Jean Todt to discuss the urgent global road safety crisis.

blocks.text: In this Rappler Talk episode, multimedia reporter Patrick Cruz sits down with former Ferrari CEO and UN Special Envoy for Road Safety Jean Todt to discuss the urgent global road safety crisis.
Every year, roughly 1.16 million people lose their lives in road traffic crashes, and 92% of these deaths happen in low- and middle-income countries, according to the World Health Organization.
Catch the Rappler Talk interview airing on Tuesday, November 24, at 8 pm. – Rappler.com
